sloka: एवं बहुविधां चिन्तां चिन्तयित्वा महाकपिः ।संश्रवे मधुरं वाक्यं वैदेह्या व्याजहार ह ।। ५.३१.१।।।।
transliteration: evaṁ bahuvidhāṁ cintāṁ cintayitvā mahākapiḥ ।saṁśrave madhuraṁ vākyaṁ vaidehyā vyājahāra ha ।। 5.31.1।।।।

translations.english: After deliberating in several ways the great Hanuman spoke these sweet words to Vaidehi:
